chapter_seo_title: Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 142: The Ambush Begins
chapter_meta_description: The Southern Minor Assembly ends. Han Li refuses an invitation and is ambushed minutes later by a two-man team using tracking powder, ice magic, and earth-binding hands. A brutal survival fight.
og_title: The Azure-Robed Daoist Reveals His True Colors!
og_description: Han Li escapes an assassination attempt by using a contortionist’s trick and raw luck, but the hunters are still on his trail.
twitter_title: Ch. 142: Han Li gets a tracking mark, an ambush, and two deep stab wounds. Just another Wednesday in the Mortal Stream.
twitter_description: The Southern Assembly ends, the knives come out. Han Li fights off a two-man assassination team using flexibility, bone dislocation, and cold calculation.
